subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature automatically corrects common typing mistakes, such as changing 'teh' to 'the' as you type?
explanation: AutoCorrect replaces commonly mistyped words with the correct spelling while you type.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature is used to find synonyms of a word?
explanation: The Thesaurus suggests synonyms (and antonyms) for the selected word.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word ribbon tab contains the options to add a table, picture or chart to a document?
explanation: Tables, pictures, shapes and charts are all added from the Insert tab.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, the blank space between the text and the edges of the page is called the:
explanation: Margins are the empty areas at the top, bottom, left and right of a page.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, which feature automatically moves text to the next line when it reaches the right margin?
explanation: Word wrap moves words that do not fit on the current line to the next line automatically, so you do not need to press Enter.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, the blinking vertical line that shows where the next character will appear is called the:
explanation: The insertion point, or cursor, marks where typed text will be inserted.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, text placed in the header appears:
options: At the bottom of every page
At the top of every page
explanation: The header is the area at the top margin of each page; the footer is at the bottom.

subject: computer
question: What is the default page orientation of a new document in MS Word?
explanation: New Word documents open in portrait orientation, which is taller than it is wide.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word ribbon tab contains font options such as Bold, Italic and font size?
explanation: The Home tab holds the Clipboard, Font, Paragraph and Styles groups.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a named set of formatting such as 'Heading 1' that can be applied in one click is called a:
explanation: Styles keep formatting consistent and are also used to build a Table of Contents.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a note placed at the end of the document or section rather than at the bottom of the page is called a/an:
explanation: Endnotes are collected at the end of a document or section, while footnotes appear on the same page.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature is used to send the same letter to many people with each copy personalised with a different name and address?
explanation: Mail Merge combines a main document with a data source to produce personalised copies.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature displays the number of words, characters and paragraphs in a document?
explanation: Word Count is on the Review tab and is also shown on the status bar.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature arranges text into side-by-side vertical sections like a newspaper?
explanation: The Columns option on the Layout tab divides text into two or more newspaper-style columns.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word tool copies the formatting of selected text so it can be applied to other text?
explanation: Format Painter copies formatting, not content, from one place to another.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, faint text such as 'CONFIDENTIAL' printed behind the main text of every page is called a:
explanation: A watermark appears lightly in the background of each page; it is added from the Design tab.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, the first line of a paragraph left alone at the bottom of a page is called a/an:
explanation: An orphan is a paragraph's first line stranded at the bottom of a page; Widow/Orphan control prevents it.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word page setup, the extra margin space added for binding a document is called the:
explanation: The gutter margin adds space on the binding side so text is not hidden.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a note printed at the bottom of the same page to explain a point in the text is called a/an:
explanation: Footnotes appear at the bottom of the page where they are referenced; endnotes are collected at the end of the document or section.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word mail merge, the file that holds the list of names and addresses is called the:
explanation: The data source holds the variable information merged into the main document.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature records every insertion and deletion made by reviewers so they can later be accepted or rejected?
explanation: Track Changes marks edits so the author can review and accept or reject each one.

subject: computer
question: Which MS Word feature automatically builds a list of headings with their page numbers, usually at the start of a document?
explanation: A Table of Contents is generated from heading styles and shows each heading with its page number.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, changing a page from portrait to landscape changes its:
explanation: Orientation sets whether the page is taller (portrait) or wider (landscape).

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a large capital letter at the beginning of a paragraph that extends down several lines is called a:
explanation: A Drop Cap enlarges the first letter of a paragraph across several lines.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word mail merge, the placeholders such as «Name» and «Address» inserted in the main document are called:
explanation: Merge fields are replaced with data from the data source for each record.

subject: computer
question: What is the default file extension of a macro-enabled document in MS Word 2007 and later?
explanation: The 'm' in .docm marks a macro-enabled document; .docx cannot store macros and .dotx is a template.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, which view shows a document as it would appear in a web browser?
explanation: Web Layout view displays the document as a web page, without page breaks.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a hanging indent means:
options: All lines except the first line of a paragraph are indented
Only the first line is indented
Text hangs outside the right margin
explanation: Hanging indents are commonly used in bibliographies and numbered lists.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, clicking the Show/Hide (¶) button displays:
options: Non-printing characters such as paragraph marks and spaces
explanation: These formatting marks help in editing but are not printed.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, a named location in a document that can be jumped to through Go To or a hyperlink is called a:
explanation: Bookmarks are added from Insert > Links and are useful in long documents.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, the last line of a paragraph printed by itself at the top of a page is called a:
explanation: Microsoft calls this a widow; an orphan is the first line left alone at the bottom of a page.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, Overtype mode, toggled with the Insert key when enabled, causes typed text to:
options: Be inserted without moving existing text
Replace the characters to the right of the cursor
explanation: In Insert mode new text pushes existing text right; in Overtype mode it overwrites it.

subject: computer
question: In MS Word, to have a landscape page in the middle of a portrait document, you must insert a:
explanation: Section breaks allow different page layout settings, such as orientation, in parts of one document.
